title: Review URL percent escaping sets, from whatwg.

comments.author: elupus
comments.body: This looks weird. I could be wrong. But should the userinfo field contain partial escapes? The trialing % sign change here seem odd.
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: Questions an escaping result that leaves a partial percent-escape in userinfo, i.e. the behaviour under test looks wrong, not just its wording.
